controls.title: The Contractor shall provide adequate security on all covered contractor information systems, implementing at a minimum the protections in (b)(1)–(3)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Contractor shall provide adequate security on all covered contractor information systems, implementing at a minimum the protections in (b)(1)–(3)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cloud computing services operated on behalf of the Government are subject to the security requirements of clause 252.239-7010, Cloud Computing Services

controls.title: Any other IT service or system operated on behalf of the Government (other than cloud computing) is subject to the security requirements specified elsewhere in the contract

controls.title: The covered contractor information system is subject to the security requirements in NIST SP 800-171 in effect at the time the solicitation is issued or as authorized by the Contracting Officer (asses

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The covered contractor information system is subject to the security requirements in NIST SP 800-171 in effect at the time the solicitation is issued or as authorized by the Contracting Officer (assess with frameworks/federal/nist/sp_800_171)

controls.title: The Contractor shall implement NIST SP 800-171 as soon as practical, but not later than December 31, 2017

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Contractor shall implement NIST SP 800-171 as soon as practical, but not later than December 31, 2017

controls.title: For contracts awarded prior to October 1, 2017, the Contractor shall notify the DoD CIO within 30 days of contract award of any NIST SP 800-171 security requirements not implemented at the time of awa

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: For contracts awarded prior to October 1, 2017, the Contractor shall notify the DoD CIO within 30 days of contract award of any NIST SP 800-171 security requirements not implemented at the time of award

controls.title: Requests to vary from NIST SP 800-171 are submitted in writing to the Contracting Officer for consideration by the DoD CIO; only requirements adjudicated by an authorized DoD CIO representative as non

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Requests to vary from NIST SP 800-171 are submitted in writing to the Contracting Officer for consideration by the DoD CIO; only requirements adjudicated by an authorized DoD CIO representative as nonapplicable or with an equally effective alternative are not implemented

controls.title: Where the DoD CIO has previously adjudicated a requirement as not applicable or an alternative as equally effective, a copy of that approval is provided to the Contracting Officer when requesting its

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where the DoD CIO has previously adjudicated a requirement as not applicable or an alternative as equally effective, a copy of that approval is provided to the Contracting Officer when requesting its recognition under this contract

controls.title: The Contractor shall require and ensure that the cloud service provider complies with paragraphs (c) through (g) of the clause: cyber incident reporting, malicious software, media preservation and pro

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Contractor shall require and ensure that the cloud service provider complies with paragraphs (c) through (g) of the clause: cyber incident reporting, malicious software, media preservation and protection, access for forensic analysis, and cyber incident damage assessment

controls.title: The Contractor shall require and ensure that an external cloud service provider storing, processing or transmitting covered defense information meets security requirements equivalent to those establis

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Contractor shall require and ensure that an external cloud service provider storing, processing or transmitting covered defense information meets security requirements equivalent to those established by the Government for the FedRAMP Moderate baseline

controls.title: Other information systems security measures are applied when the Contractor reasonably determines they may be required to provide adequate security in a dynamic environment, to accommodate special cir

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Other information systems security measures are applied when the Contractor reasonably determines they may be required to provide adequate security in a dynamic environment, to accommodate special circumstances (e.g., medical devices), or for individual, isolated or temporary deficiencies based on an assessed risk or vulnerability (may be addressed in a system security plan)

controls.title: On discovering a cyber incident affecting a covered contractor information system, the covered defense information in it, or the ability to perform operationally critical support, the Contractor condu

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: On discovering a cyber incident affecting a covered contractor information system, the covered defense information in it, or the ability to perform operationally critical support, the Contractor conducts a review for evidence of compromise of covered defense information — compromised computers, servers, specific data and user accounts — including other systems on the Contractor's networks that may have been accessed

controls.title: The Contractor rapidly reports cyber incidents to DoD at https://dibnet.dod.mil — "rapidly report" means within 72 hours of discovery of any cyber incident ((a))

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Contractor rapidly reports cyber incidents to DoD at https://dibnet.dod.mil — "rapidly report" means within 72 hours of discovery of any cyber incident ((a))

controls.title: The cyber incident report is treated as information created by or for DoD and includes, at a minimum, the required elements at https://dibnet.dod.mil

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The cyber incident report is treated as information created by or for DoD and includes, at a minimum, the required elements at https://dibnet.dod.mil

controls.title: The Contractor or subcontractor has or acquires a DoD-approved medium assurance certificate to report cyber incidents

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Contractor or subcontractor has or acquires a DoD-approved medium assurance certificate to report cyber incidents

controls.title: Malicious software discovered and isolated in connection with a reported cyber incident is submitted to the DoD Cyber Crime Center (DC3) in accordance with DC3 or Contracting Officer instructions, and

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Malicious software discovered and isolated in connection with a reported cyber incident is submitted to the DoD Cyber Crime Center (DC3) in accordance with DC3 or Contracting Officer instructions, and not sent to the Contracting Officer

controls.title: Images of all known affected information systems identified under (c)(1)(i) and all relevant monitoring/packet capture data are preserved and protected for at least 90 days from submission of the cybe

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Images of all known affected information systems identified under (c)(1)(i) and all relevant monitoring/packet capture data are preserved and protected for at least 90 days from submission of the cyber incident report

controls.title: Upon request by DoD, the Contractor provides DoD with access to additional information or equipment necessary to conduct a forensic analysis

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Upon request by DoD, the Contractor provides DoD with access to additional information or equipment necessary to conduct a forensic analysis

controls.title: If DoD elects to conduct a damage assessment, the Contractor provides, on the Contracting Officer's request, all of the damage assessment information gathered in accordance with paragraph (e)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: If DoD elects to conduct a damage assessment, the Contractor provides, on the Contracting Officer's request, all of the damage assessment information gathered in accordance with paragraph (e)

parts.prose: To the maximum extent practicable, the Contractor identifies and marks attributional/proprietary information

controls.title: The Contractor conducts activities under the clause in accordance with applicable laws and regulations on the interception, monitoring, access, use and disclosure of electronic communications and data

parts.prose: The Contractor conducts activities under the clause in accordance with applicable laws and regulations on the interception, monitoring, access, use and disclosure of electronic communications and data

controls.title: The clause, including paragraph (m), is included without alteration (except to identify the parties) in subcontracts or similar instruments for operationally critical support or whose performance invo

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The clause, including paragraph (m), is included without alteration (except to identify the parties) in subcontracts or similar instruments for operationally critical support or whose performance involves covered defense information, including subcontracts for commercial products or commercial services

controls.title: The Contractor determines whether information required for subcontractor performance retains its identity as covered defense information requiring protection under the clause, consulting the Contracti

parts.prose: The Contractor determines whether information required for subcontractor performance retains its identity as covered defense information requiring protection under the clause, consulting the Contracting Officer if necessary
